item.title: The Rise of Smash-and-Grab Diplomacy in a World of Resource Scarcity
item.description: The United States is now engaged in what I am calling "smash-and-grab" diplomacy in Venezuela, and it will perhaps soon do the same in Greenland, a territory of the Kingdom of Denmark. item.description: Few debates in Brussels carry as much emotional charge as critical raw materials. item.title: Cheap Oil Is Double-Edged Sword for Trump
item.description: One of the campaign promises of President Donald Trump was to secure affordable energy for Americans. item.title: Unrest in Iran Pushes Oil Prices Higher
item.description: Oil prices continued to climb early on Tuesday as markets focused on unrest in Iran and the risk of a U.S. intervention disrupting supply in the world's most important oil region. At the time of writing, WTI Crude was trading around $59.74 per barrel, up 0.4%, while Brent Crude was near $64.09, 0.34% higher.
